<style>
/* ── Gallery grid ── */
.photo-gallery {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin: 2rem 0;
}

.gallery-section-title {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #555;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  margin: 2.5rem 0 0.75rem 0;
  padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
}

.gallery-item {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
  background: #eee;
}

.gallery-item img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  display: block;
}

.gallery-item:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

/* ── Lightbox ── */
.lightbox-overlay {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.88);
  z-index: 9999;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

.lightbox-overlay.active {
  display: flex;
}

.lightbox-overlay img {
  max-width: 90vw;
  max-height: 78vh;
  border-radius: 8px;
  object-fit: contain;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}

.lightbox-caption {
  color: #e8e8e8;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 600px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-style: italic;
}

.lightbox-close {
  position: fixed;
  top: 1.2rem;
  right: 1.5rem;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: white;
  font-size: 2rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1;
  opacity: 0.8;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}

.lightbox-close:hover { opacity: 1; }

.lightbox-nav {
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border: none;
  color: white;
  font-size: 2rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.2s;
}
.lightbox-nav:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
.lightbox-nav.prev { left: 1rem; }
.lightbox-nav.next { right: 1rem; }

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .photo-gallery { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
</style>

<script>
const photos = [
  // Birds
  { src: "about/me_and_brownnoddy.JPG",                    caption: "With a brown noddy (Anous stolidus) — an unforgettable encounter on Aride Island, Seychelles." },
  { src: "about/me_lookingatbird.jpg",                     caption: "Behavioural observation of seabirds during my volunteer research stay in Seychelles (2020–2021)." },
  { src: "about/save_chick_bird.jpg",                      caption: "Helping to ring a Seychelles Magpie robin chick" },
  { src: "about/me_and_whitetailedtropicbird.jpg",         caption: "Saving a white-tailed tropicbird (Phaethon lepturus) from bird-catcher tree (Pisonia grandis) seeds" },
  { src: "about/fairytern_and_pisonia.jpg",                caption: "White fairy tern (Gygis alba) with bird-catcher tree (Pisonia grandis) seeds" },
  { src: "about/seychellesmagpierobin.jpg",                caption: "The Seychelles magpie-robin (Copsychus sechellarum), a critically endangered species (was once one of the rarest birds in the world)"},
  { src: "about/tropical_shearwater_chick.jpg",            caption: "Tropical shearwater chick (Puffinus bailloni) — seen during a census monitoring" },
  { src: "about/white_tailedtropicbird_adultandchick.jpg", caption: "Adult and chick of white-tailed tropicbird (Phaethon lepturus)" },
  { src: "about/whitetailedtropicbird_chick.jpg",          caption: "White-tailed tropicbird chick" },
  // Turtles
  { src: "about/hawksbill turtle.jpg",                     caption: "Hawksbill sea turtle (Eretmochelys imbricata) laying eggs" },
  { src: "about/hawksbill_turtle.jpg",                     caption: "Back to ocean !" },
  { src: "about/hawksbillturtle_and_lizard.jpg",           caption: "An unlikely encounter: a hawksbill turtle and a skink above its shell" },
  { src: "about/monitoring_hackswbillturtle.jpg",          caption: "Hawksbill turtle monitoring — biometric measurements and tagging operations." },
  { src: "about/me_and_giantaldabratortoise.jpg",          caption: "With a giant Aldabra tortoise (Aldabrachelys gigantea)" },
  // Science & Teaching
  { src: "about/nowpas_oral.jpeg",                         caption: "Oral presentation at the NOWPAS Workshop (Hólar, Iceland, February 2026) on fine-scale genetic structure in Atlantic salmon." },
  { src: "about/ecology_andbehaviour.jpg",                 caption: "17th Ecology & Behaviour Conference (Montpellier, August 2025) — talk on reproductive success of dispersers in Atlantic salmon." },
  { src: "about/eseb_poster.jpeg",                         caption: "Poster session at the European Society for Evolutionary Biology congress (ESEB, Barcelona, August 2025)." },
  { src: "about/cours_instituagro.jpeg",                   caption: "Teaching at Institut Agro Rennes" },
  { src: "about/fieldwork_boat_niskin.JPG",                caption: "At-sea sampling with a Niskin bottle during my Master 1" },
  { src: "about/monitoring_cetaceans.jpg",                caption: "Cetacean monitoring off the coast of Mallorca during my internship at Tursiops Marine Research (2022)." },
  { src: "about/Emilio Egal, décoder le comportement des saumons face au climat.mp4", caption: "Video interview — Decoding salmon behaviour facing climate change (INRAE, 2025).", isVideo: true },
];

let currentIndex = 0;

function openLightbox(index) {
  currentIndex = index;
  updateLightbox();
  document.getElementById("lightbox").classList.add("active");
  document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
}

function updateLightbox() {
  const photo = photos[currentIndex];
  const img = document.getElementById("lightbox-img");
  let videoEl = document.getElementById("lightbox-video");

  if (photo.isVideo) {
    img.style.display = "none";
    if (!videoEl) {
      videoEl = document.createElement("video");
      videoEl.id = "lightbox-video";
      videoEl.controls = true;
      videoEl.style.cssText = "max-width:90vw;max-height:78vh;border-radius:8px;";
      img.parentNode.insertBefore(videoEl, img);
    }
    videoEl.src = photo.src;
    videoEl.style.display = "block";
    videoEl.play();
  } else {
    img.style.display = "block";
    img.src = photo.src;
    img.alt = photo.caption;
    if (videoEl) { videoEl.pause(); videoEl.style.display = "none"; }
  }

  document.getElementById("lightbox-caption").textContent = photo.caption;
}

function closeLightbox() {
  document.getElementById("lightbox").classList.remove("active");
  document.body.style.overflow = "";
  const videoEl = document.getElementById("lightbox-video");
  if (videoEl) videoEl.pause();
}

function closeLightboxOnBg(event) {
  if (event.target === document.getElementById("lightbox")) closeLightbox();
}

function navigateLightbox(dir) {
  currentIndex = (currentIndex + dir + photos.length) % photos.length;
  updateLightbox();
}

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const lb = document.getElementById("lightbox");
  if (!lb.classList.contains("active")) return;
  if (e.key === "Escape") closeLightbox();
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") navigateLightbox(1);
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") navigateLightbox(-1);
});
</script>
